summary: openai 0.x APIs (openai.ChatCompletion.create, openai.Completion, module-level api_key) were removed in 1.0 (Nov 2023). The SDK is now 3.x: client = OpenAI(); client.responses.create(...) / client.chat.completions.create(...). 3.0 switched the HTTP client to HTTPX2.

replacements.name: openai migrate
replacements.when: grit-based codemod from the v1 migration guide (commit first, review the diff)
